pages.text: Quick Start for Easy Installation The following information is provided to aid in the installation of the INpy 500 Twin game. For complete instructions, field service, and maintenance, please tefer to the Invy 500 Twin Owner's Manual. 1. Uncrate and move the Inpy 500 Twin cabinets to their final locations. Use four (4) 4 people to uncrate and move the | Inpy 500 Twin cabinets. See the | figure for minimum installation dimensions. 2. Inspect the Inpy 500 Twin cabinets inside and = *""* | out for damage. (The Coin | Mech Door key is tied on the | Controls. The rest of the keys are | hanging behind the Coin Mech | Door.) Contact the distributor for instructions if damage is found. | Remove the blue trim protector from all silver trim strips. 3. Remove the top two bolts and washers from the right-side cabinet, hang the Cash Box Tower on the right-side cabinet, and attach the right-side cabinet to the Cash Box Tower using the four bolts and washers (some tools in the cash box). Connect the right-side connectors. 4. Attach the left-side cabinet to the Cash Box Tower as in to step 3, using the attached hardware (some tools in the cash box). Connect the left-side connectors. 5. Adjust the six leg levelers on the Cabinet until the Cabinet is level and the two casters are at least 5 mm above the floor. Install the joint plate between the left- and right-side inside Jeg levelers 6. Install the Billboard (packed in the cabinet) above the Marquee, using the twelve bolts, washers and L-brackets attached to the cabinet and bill- board (some tools in the cash box). 7. Connect the linking cable at the back of the cabinet: red to RX, black to TX. 8. Plug in and turn on the Inpy 500 Twin game. The AC cord and switch are located on the lower rear of the cabinet. 8. Adjust the Game Board Default Settings as required. See the back of this Quickstart Card, and, for more details, see the Inpy 500 Twin Owner's Manual (shipped in the Coin Box). 9. Set the Control Range ("Volume") Settings. Otherwise, game controls will not work properly. For more details, see the Inpy 500 Twin Owner's Manual (shipped in the Coin Box). 10. Play the Inpy 500 Twin game! WARNING! NEW FOR INSTALLATION Control Range (“Volume”) Setting Test must be performed for game controls to work properly.
